full_prompt_en: A square conceptual color photograph shows a dense plume of vivid pink smoke spreading low over a still mountain lake at dusk. The upper portion is an open pale cyan sky, shifting toward cooler blue above several overlapping mountain ridges. The ridges cross the middle distance as soft silhouettes, darkest toward the left and lower slopes, with a rounded peak rising near the right of center. Trees form a deep blue-green band below them, nearly merging with the dark waterline. From the right shore, a bright narrow stream of pink smoke pushes horizontally toward the center before expanding into thick, irregular clouds. The largest billows gather left of center, with rounded cauliflower-like lobes rising and falling against the shaded trees. Cooler mauve shadows develop inside the plume, while some upper edges glow coral pink. The nearly motionless water below reflects the cloud as a softened, darker pink mass, creating a strong horizontal symmetry through the central waterline. On the lower right, a sloped rocky shore enters diagonally, its small dark stones and rough earth providing a firm foreground edge. The far right edge is bordered by shadowed foliage, partly hiding the origin of the smoke. Soft ambient evening light leaves the hills subdued, making the saturated cloud the decisive visual accent; its reflection gives a second, dimmer area of color. Fine photographic grain and atmospheric haze keep the distant shapes gentle, while the smoky edge is more intricate and turbulent. No person or readable text is visible. The overall composition sets an unstable, luminous color event within a calm blue landscape, balancing mirrored forms and dark framing edges in a quiet surreal mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形观念彩色摄影展现一团浓密鲜粉色烟云，在暮色中贴着寂静的山间湖面扩散。上方是开阔的淡青色天空，在数层重叠的山脊上方转向较冷的蓝色。山脊以柔和剪影横穿中景，左侧与低坡更暗，中央偏右隆起一座圆顶。山下的树木形成深蓝绿色带，几乎与深色水线融为一体。亮粉色的窄烟流从右岸水平推向中央，然后膨胀成厚重、不规则的云团。最大的一群烟卷聚在中央偏左，圆鼓鼓、仿佛花椰菜的团块在背阴树前上下起伏。烟内部出现较冷的淡紫色阴影，某些上缘则闪着珊瑚粉。下方近乎静止的湖水把烟云映为更柔、更暗的粉色团块，以中央水线形成强烈的水平对称。右下方，一道倾斜的多石湖岸斜向进入画面，细小深色石块与粗糙泥土形成稳固的前景边缘。最右侧有背阴叶丛框住画边，也部分挡住了烟的起点。柔和的傍晚环境光让群山沉静下来，使饱和烟云成为决定性的视觉重音；倒影又添上一片更暗的色彩。细摄影颗粒和大气薄霾让远景形状柔和，而烟的边缘更复杂、更翻腾。画中看不到人或可读文字。整体构图把一个不稳定、发光般的色彩事件放进平静的蓝色风景中，以镜像形态和暗色边缘形成平衡，带来安静的超现实气氛。
style_prompt_en: The photographic style places a single saturated, cloudlike color field against cool, low-contrast surroundings. Soft atmospheric layers recede through cyan, slate blue, and deep blue-green, while the vivid accent changes from glowing edges to muted internal shadows. An almost horizontal division allows the bright form to repeat as a darker, softer reflection, giving the image measured symmetry without rigid geometry. Rounded turbulent textures contrast with broad smooth color gradients and quiet negative space. Foreground edges remain dark and tactile, helping the luminous middle zone stand forward. Diffuse ambient light suppresses ordinary detail, while local brightness within the saturated shape creates the focal point. The overall effect is spacious and uncanny, combining calm photographic depth with a controlled burst of chromatic energy.
style_prompt_zh: 这种摄影风格将一片饱和、云状的色场放在冷调而低对比的环境前。柔和的大气层次经青色、石板蓝和深蓝绿依次退远，鲜亮重音则从发光的外缘变化为内部压低的阴影。近乎水平的分界让亮色形态以更暗、更柔的倒影重复，构成有节制的对称，却没有僵硬几何。圆鼓而翻腾的纹理与宽阔平滑的色彩渐层和安静留白对照。前景边缘保持暗沉且可触，使明亮的中部区域向前突出。弥散环境光压低寻常细节，饱和形态内部的局部亮度则形成焦点。整体效果开阔而奇异，将平静的摄影纵深与受控的色彩爆发结合。
theme_en: A vivid pink smoke plume mirrored in a still mountain lake
theme_zh: 鲜粉色烟云映在寂静的山间湖面
name: Filippo Minelli
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
